title: External standard (one faceted external-registry row) v0.2
description: Validates one row of external/external-standards.csv projected as a JSON object. External standards are the discoverable reference standards of the unified registry: many, faceted, and NOT MMDG nodes until instantiated by a future external-to-internal transform (out of scope here). Distinct from the internal meta-model record (registry-node.schema.json): an external standard carries the source catalogue columns plus the two facet axes, but not the MMDG node profile (no csn, role, exports, requires, sync_contract, edges). CSV-to-JSON field mapping is a fixed lower_snake_case transform of the source headers, which the import tool (tools/import_external.py) and CI (ci/check_facets.py) both follow: Group to group, Name to name, Acronym to acronym, SpecificationSourceURL to specification_source_url, Category to category, ParentModel to parent_model, SimilarModels to similar_models, Maintainer to maintainer, Format to format, Status to status, NamespaceURI to namespace_uri, Year to year, Notes to notes, CompositionalRole to compositional_role, DefaultLinkType to default_link_type. To the source columns the importer adds three facet fields: origin (const external), industry (the sector axis, inherited from the row's Group through facets/group-industry-map.csv, at least one code), and optional cluster (the ontological axis). Required: name, group, origin, industry. Every other field is optional because many source cells are blank. compositional_role binds to the ARCH-016 compositional roles R1 to R8 and default_link_type to their default link types; the role names, meanings and default link types are the single materialized vocabulary in facets/compositional-roles.yaml and facets/link-types.yaml and are cited by ID here, not restated. Cites ARCH-016, ARCH-017, ARCH-018.

group.description: Source column Group. The external-registry group the standard belongs to, one of the thirty-seven groups the source catalogue partitions into. The importer inherits industry from this value through facets/group-industry-map.csv. Required.

name.description: Source column Name. Human-readable name of the standard. Required.

acronym.description: Source column Acronym. Short display acronym; may be empty in the source.

specification_source_url.description: Source column SpecificationSourceURL. A URI to the authoritative specification, or the empty string when the source cell is blank. Format uri is an annotation; the empty-string case is the blank-cell case.

category.description: Source column Category. Free-text kind of artifact (Framework, Schema Language, Ontology, Format, and so on); may be empty.

parent_model.description: Source column ParentModel. The model this one derives from or specializes, as free text; may be empty or a dash in the source.

similar_models.description: Source column SimilarModels. Free-text list of related or comparable standards; may be empty.

maintainer.description: Source column Maintainer. The organization or body that maintains the standard; may be empty.

format.description: Source column Format. Free-text serialization or modeling form; may be empty.

status.description: Source column Status. Free-text maturity or standardization status (for example W3C Recommendation, ISO Standard, Draft); may be empty. This is the external catalogue status string, not the internal-node lifecycle vocabulary.

namespace_uri.description: Source column NamespaceURI. The canonical namespace URI where one exists; may be empty.

year.description: Source column Year. Publication or revision year as free text (single years, ranges, or slashed pairs such as 2004 / 2014 all occur), so it is a string, not a number; may be empty.

notes.description: Source column Notes. Free-text editorial notes; may be empty.

compositional_role.description: Source column CompositionalRole. The ARCH-016 compositional role of the standard, one of R1 to R8, or empty when unclassified. The role names and meanings are the vocabulary in facets/compositional-roles.yaml, cited by ID here.

default_link_type.description: Source column DefaultLinkType. The ARCH-016 default link type implied by the compositional role; the role-to-link-type mapping and the link-type vocabulary live in facets/compositional-roles.yaml and facets/link-types.yaml, cited by ID here. The literal N/A is a valid value (R8 tooling with no default link); empty when unclassified.

origin.description: Facet field added by the importer. Always external for an external-standards row: this record is a discovery entry for a standard authored outside the registry governance domain, not an internal meta-model node. Required.

industry.description: Facet field, the sector axis: which sector uses or governs the standard. At least one lower-kebab code from facets/industry.yaml (scheme vercy-industry). The importer inherits these from the row's Group through facets/group-industry-map.csv, which maps each of the thirty-seven source groups to one or more industry codes. Orthogonal to cluster. Required, minItems 1.

cluster.description: Optional facet field, the ontological axis: what the standard is, one or more of the fifteen ontological clusters (codes from facets/clusters.yaml). Optional for external standards in v0.2; the enum matches the cluster field of registry-node.schema.json. Orthogonal to industry.
